title: Unit 1 Review + Mission: Three Introductions
objective: Review Unit 1, then introduce yourself to three AI characters with the right formality.
intro_md:
[L1: The last lesson of Unit 1! First, a short review of everything: greetings, names, countries, jobs, numbers, polite phrases. Then your mission — introduce yourself to three different people: a teacher, a student like you, and an office worker. Each one needs different words. Formal: Good morning + Ms/Mr and a last name. Friendly: Hi! and first names. Your repair phrases are always allowed — using them is part of a good score.]
{{l1_contrast:register_formality}}
notes: TODO_audio: exercise 6 needs recorded audio; the quoted text stands in for the recording. Review half (ex 1-8) samples every vocab lesson of the unit per the layered-review rules (unit cumulative review, L18 first half); mission half (ex 9-11) is the band's Three Introductions mission (teacher / peer / office clerk register variants). Mission contract EN-U01-L18-M01A/B/C to be authored as ai_interaction_specs when that table lands.

exercises.prompt: hello · good morning · What's your name? · Where are you from? · What do you do? · Can you repeat that, please? · Nice to meet you. · see you later
exercises.rationale: Retrieval sweep across all six vocab lessons of the unit before the performance; the result feeds the per-skill mastery snapshot the unit review must generate.

exercises.prompt: [L1: Formal or friendly? Match each greeting to the right situation.]

pairs.right: [L1: formal — a teacher or an office]

exercises.rationale: Register choice is the scored dimension of the mission (L01 culture note: hi vs good morning); the three-way sort maps one greeting to each of the three mission characters.

exercises.prompt: A: ___ you from Mexico?  B: Yes, I ___.
exercises.rationale: L07-L09 be review under mixed conditions; 'Do' catches the predicted overgeneralization from L13's What do you do? back onto be-questions.
G4 spot-check with the vowel/consonant pair from L13; article drop before jobs remains the top predicted es/zh error and must survive a week of new material.

exercises.prompt: [L1: Put the words in order. You will need this question in your mission.]
exercises.rationale: Re-assembles the L15 repair chunk the office-clerk mission will demand; also reviews do-question word order as a fixed shape before U2 analyzes it.

exercises.prompt: [audio, 0.75x] 'My phone number is five-five-five, two-zero-one-four.' — [L1: Which numbers do you hear at the end?]
exercises.rationale: Numbers decay fastest under FSRS; digit-by-digit phone exchange (L11) returns in the office-clerk mission, so the grouping-pause listening skill gets one last activation.

options.label: two-zero-one-four
options.rationale: Digit by digit with grouping pauses — the pause marks where the group starts.

options.label: two-zero-four-one
options.rationale: Last two digits flipped — order inside the group matters.

options.label: two-one-zero-four
options.rationale: Middle digits swapped; the grouping pauses tell you where each number sits.

exercises.prompt: [L1: Complete your introduction.] Hello! My ___ is Dana. I'm ___ Ukraine. I'm ___ artist.
exercises.rationale: The three self-introduction frames (name / origin / job) assembled into the mission's core move; 'a artist' re-tests a/an under load and the frame distractors catch word-for-word template errors.

exercises.prompt: [L1: Your last check before the mission: what does each phrase do?]

pairs.right: [L1: the meaning is not clear to me]

exercises.rationale: Final activation of the repair moves minutes before they are needed; in the mission they are always permitted and using them scores positively (band repair-first design).

exercises.prompt: [L1: MISSION 1 of 3 — your new teacher. Greet formally (Good morning + Ms or Mr), give your full name, spell your last name, and say where you are from.]
exercises.rationale: Formal register variant of the mission; spelling aloud recycles L02 under pressure; scored on register match plus task completion per the mission contract.

exercises.prompt: [L1: MISSION 2 of 3 — a student in your class. Greet like a friend, ask their name and country, answer their questions, and close with See you later.]
exercises.rationale: Informal register variant; the learner initiates the questions (role balance trained in L17), shifting from answering to leading the exchange.

exercises.prompt: [L1: MISSION 3 of 3 — an office worker needs your information for a form. Answer: name, spelling, country, phone number. The worker talks fast — use your repair phrases.]
exercises.rationale: Transactional register variant closing the unit: recycles L11 phone numbers and L12 form fields orally, and the deliberately fast speech makes repair use observable and scoreable.
